dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: Ugh, I'm so bored... Gotta keep it together somehow...!

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: Hello there, citizen. This military installation is under the Druzhna's jurisdiction. If you have no urgent business here, please go no further.

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: See you, citizen. Have a pleasant day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you always standing guard here?

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: Of course. As you can see, I am fulfilling our formation's most sacred duty, defending these three square meters of sacred Snezhnayan soil!

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: You won't find me slacking off until a new squad member replaces me... Probably, anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bit of a boring job, eh, this standing guard business?

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: A little, I must admit... Watching my colleagues come in and out always gets me thinking about when I can be assigned more... You know, "mobile" duties.

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: But the commander said this: "They who cannot conquer boring posts will not defeat real foes."

dialogues.speaker: Musina
dialogues.text: And so you'll find me standing here, still as an ice sculpture, until the horn is sounded!
